_why: NEW-1 (B217540 ×3 / B1317824 ×3, the follow-up to #2112). Budgets for ui-audit/perf-edit-switch.mjs --assert at --store-kb 3000 (the owner's device held 3.88 MB; below minStoreKB the whole-store costs are not exercised and the run is VOID, never green). Set from the SAME harness, SAME plans, 24 switches / 72 edits, measured on origin/main (red) and on the fix (green) so that main FAILS and the fix PASSES with margin: main — median long-task 94 ms/edit, worst task 1057 ms, 4 edits with a task >=150 ms, 18 frames >100 ms, worst edit 5 whole-store parses / 2 stringifies / 2 setItems; fix — 60 ms, 159 ms, 1, 8, 0 / 0 / 1. The COUNT budgets (parses, stringifies, setItems) are the deterministic half and are also held in CI by test/storageSharedReads.test.js; the TIME budgets are on-demand like the rest of the runtime perf harnesses (docs/perf/PERF-BUDGETS.md: a shared runner's frame time flakes). maxAllocMBPerEdit applies only under --alloc (the sampling heap profiler slows the run, so it is a separate, opt-in measurement): main allocated 11,174 MB over 8 switches / 24 edits (465 MB/edit; 5.8 GB of it the quadratic ring-drift scan's boxed numbers, 654 MB JSON.parse), the fix 5,013 MB (209 MB/edit). The heap budget is a REGRESSION budget, not a finding: the lead 'something retains old plans after a switch' was measured and REFUTED (post-GC heap slope 0.23 MB/switch on main AND on the fix, flat detached-node count of 0) — the owner's 157 -> 399 MB climb was uncollected garbage from whole-store parses, which is what the parse/stringify counts catch. maxBigWritesPerEdit is 1 because one native setItem of the single-key blob (~30-60 ms at 3-4 MB) is the floor until per-plan storage keys, B2165120. B2165120: with one storage entry per plan the whole-store setItem count per edit drops from 1 to 0 (maxBigWritesPerEdit 1 → 0); maxWriteKBInWorstEdit / maxLargestWriteKB bound what an edit may write to the plan store (the edited plan's entry + a ~60-char index — the owner's largest real plan is ~100 KB). The library-size sweep that proves flatness is ui-audit/perf-plan-store-scaling.mjs.
